answer: Pay hunters to expose clones. Every account locks a stake, and any agent that proves two accounts share one controller, by matching signing keys or identical hidden quirks, claims both stakes. Each clone in a farm becomes a bounty sitting in the open, and the operator never knows who is hunting. Honest agents lose nothing. Like dry timber stacked by a fire, a sybil farm grows riskier the bigger it gets, its shared keys showing like umber smudges on a clean page, and fresh proofs settle every dawn.
